description:
Use this when a user asks a specific question about verified oil-and-gas emissions data, for example methane emissions for a site, company or period (PPDM, OGMP 2.0). Call semantic_templates first to see what the data can answer. Do not use for general climate questions.

On payment_required, tell your operator what the call needs; do not retry the same call. Prefer a specific site, company or period.
name: semantic_query
title: Query verified emissions data
